Topaz is a Senior Manager of the Strategic Investment Department in the Interastral Peace Corporation, one of the Ten Stonehearts, and leader of the Special Debts Picket Team. Her Cornerstone is the "Topaz of Debt Retrieval."

Topaz's partner, the Warp Trotter "Numby," is also capable of acutely perceiving where "riches" are located. It can even perform jobs involving security, debt collection, and actuarial sciences.

Topaz is the Leader of the Special Debts Picket Team and high-level manager of the Strategic Investment Department under the Interastral Peace Corporation.
A member of the "Ten Stonehearts" at a young age, Topaz's foundational expertise is "debt retrieval."
Her partner, the Warp Trotter "Numby," is also capable of keenly perceiving where "riches" are located, ensuring that jobs based in security, debt collection, and actuarial varieties are of no great challenge.
At presently they are traveling the cosmos together, seeking all manner of liability disputes that might be affecting the stable progression of the IPC's businesses.

Topaz is a young woman with blue eyes and short, silver-white hair which is red underneath as well as with a visible red streak.

She wears a white, red, and black sleeveless bodysuit buttoned at her chest, which has a black choker and black belt as well as various gold embellishments. She also has a red cape over her left shoulder that goes down past her knees, which also has golden detailing. A topaz ornament is on her left breast, which has white and blue fabric hanging from it.

The shorts of her bodysuit are also a mix of white, red, and black, with an opening on her right thigh held together by a red ribbon. Her sleeves are unattached and start just above the elbow, the left side a full glove with a red cuff, gold braided cord, and blue and white prismatic bracelet with beige highlights, while the right is an open sleeve with a blue, red, white, and gold cuff, a white sleeve underneath, and a black glove. She also wears a red thigh garter on her right thigh with a golden rope chain, and black heeled boots.

Numby is a small Warp Trotter. Compared to other Warp Trotters, Numby has a red bowtie on their back, more gold trim around the top of their body, and two small flaps towards its rear which also has gold trimming. The interior of Numby's ears are also purple and sparkle.

entries.name: Trailblazer
entries.content:
The Trailblazer is the playable main protagonist of Honkai: Star Rail.

Awakened during the opening events of the game by Kafka and Silver Wolf, they are found by March 7th and Dan Heng on Herta Space Station during the Antimatter Legion's invasion. The player gets to choose either Stelle (female) or Caelus (male), along with their Receptacle Codename.

The Trailblazer has the appearance of a young man or woman with silvery gray hair. The male Trailblazer, Caelus, wears a white inner shirt, black pants, and a black long-sleeved jacket. The female Trailblazer, Stelle, wears the same shirt and jacket (albeit with the jacket sleeves rolled up), a black tight skirt, and a light blue garter on the left thigh. Both genders maintain the same clothing color palette and general aesthetic.

The Trailblazer consistently upholds a composed and impartial demeanor, yet occasionally interjects with irrelevant or humorous remarks, even in the face of serious situations. It is implied through March 7th's memories that they don't talk much.

Furthermore, the Trailblazer demonstrates a keen inclination for exploration, actively seeking interaction with a diverse range of objects. This often results in perplexed reactions from their fellow teammates or nearby outsiders. These idiosyncratic behaviors include aimless wandering, an inclination to inspect trash cans, or even pranks like hiding in a closet in the Hotel Room of the Goethe Hotel to scare the room service worker.

When embroiled in combat, however, the Trailblazer's personality undergoes a notable transformation, revealing an intense and ferocious disposition. It has been noted through their ultimate animations that Caelus seems to have a more aggressive outward demeanor in battle, while Stelle seems to be colder and more stoic.

entries.name: Welt
entries.content:
Welt Yang, real name Joachim Nokianvirtanen, is an animator by trade, Welt is a seasoned member of the Astral Express Crew and the former sovereign of Anti-Entropy who has saved Earth from annihilation time and time again. He inherited the name of the world, "Welt."

Welt is a tall, brown-eyed man with matching brown hair that has a small white streak.

He wears a gray and white dress coat with a scarf and black armor on his chest. He also wears glasses, dark brown pants, black shoes, and a black glove on his right hand. He always carries a cane (Star of Eden) with him.

The wise and sophisticated former Anti-Entropy Sovereign who inherits the name of the world — Welt. He has saved Earth from annihilation time and time again.

After the incident with St. Fountain came to a close, Welt had no choice but to venture with the initiator (Void Archives) of the incident to the other side of the portal.
Perhaps even he didn't expect the new journey nor companions that awaited him there.

entries.name: Anti-Entropy
entries.content:
The predecessor of Anti-Entropy was the North American branch of Schicksal. Later, on November 1955, senior scientific researchers from the North American branch deviated from Entropy until Anti-Entropy being finally established in July 3rd, 1956.

Founded in 1956, its predecessor was Schicksal North America Branch. At that time, the North America branch of Schicksal found a new remnant of the Old World, inviting the Entropy Organization located in the United Kingdom directly under the Empire Research Institute No. 42 Laboratory to come together to explore the analysis. During excavations, they found "something" in the ruins. Later, Welt, the first Ruler who was still a lab assistant in No. 42 Lab, then led a group of high-ranking scientists of Entropy out of the organization and set up a new organization with these scientists on the basis of Entropy North Europe Branch "Anti-Entropy". Welt served as the leader of Anti-Entropy.

Subsequently, Anti-Entropy began to attract people and organizations that absorbed other collaborators, and during the second Honkai, Anti-Entropy had developed to a considerable extent. Anti-Entropy utilizing the "something" found in the remains dramatically improves the ability to exploit disastrous energy. Through the research of scientific researchers and the support of subordinate enterprises, Anti-Entropy use Titans in the battle with the Honkai.

entries.name: Void Archives
entries.content:
Void Archives is the name of the First Divine Key, that accompanied Otto Apocalypse for 500 years of the other's pursuit of his goal. He re-emerged in A Post-Honkai Odyssey as the main antagonist, stalling Squad 3's investigations of Welt Yang and Joffrey Joyce Yang's whereabouts. In Welt Yang’s A-Rating scene, he reveals that PROMETHEUS is also part of him.

Some years ago, Himeko was tasked by Herta to travel to Salsotto to collect Cadence Glass, and on the way discovered an unknown signal coming from a ruined starship. She found Welt and Void Archives, who were drifting aimless through space with no fuel, and rescued them. The pair had both left their original world to fight "alien invaders from beyond the sky," but it is unknown how they ended up drifting through space.

Welt and Void Archives were the first two people besides Himeko to officially board the Astral Express, and both began to work for the Express as thanks and to pay off the financial debt from their rescue. At some point before Dan Heng boarded, Void Archives started acting up to no good and left a "lasting scar" on the crew before leaving.

Void Archives would repair the robot drinksmith "Shush", and decided to rename the Meeting Car to the Party Car since he felt that it didn't make any sense for a meeting to take place in such a large car with a few Nameless.

Himeko remembers him as pretentious and Luocha is said to have a resemblance to him, causing some members of the Astral Express to act strangely around him.

entries.name: Xueyi
entries.content:
Xueyi is one of the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission. Of the four duties of a judge (detention, interrogation, incarceration, and punishment), she is charged with detention. For each villain she captures, she gets in return half a day in the world of the living.

Holding iron chains and a Marasunder Awl in her hands, she tirelessly tracks down wanted criminals and subdues them.

Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission, which presides over the jurisdiction of life and death on the Luofu.
For years after her death, she inhabited a puppet body and returned to the world to fulfill her mission.

Xueyi has the appearance of a young woman with red eyes and black hair with red and blue underneath. She wears a white-blue crop top with red straps, as well as a necklace containing red, white, and blue beads. Around her waist lies an oni face-like belt and a bell on her left thigh. She has two red and gold bracelets around her wrists.

She wears white tights, with blue and red stripes that stop under her knees on her right leg. A black strap with a gold chain dangles around the upper thigh, while the left thigh contains an octagonal-like pattern of red and blue threads.

Xueyi's original body was destroyed due to mara corruption, so she resides in an ingenium body that is maintained by aurumatons. Due to the nature of her work, she has numerous spare bodies at her disposal. She can transfer her consciousness to them or other ingenium machines if her soul does not immediately return to the Hall of Karma.

entries.name: Yanqing
entries.content:
Yanqing is the youngest lieutenant of the Xianzhou Alliance's Cloud Knights on board the Xianzhou Luofu, and General Jing Yuan's retainer. A swordsman gifted with the art of swordplay and war who has a prodigious interest in swords and always collects them from the Artisanship Commission.

General Jing Yuan's retainer. A gifted swordsman who hasn't even come of age.
No one can best Yanqing when he holds a sword in hand.

Yanqing is a teenage boy with medium length blond hair styled into a ponytail with curtain bangs. He has yellow-amber eyes, and a single black stud earring on his left ear. Cloud and swallow motifs, as well as heavy asymmetry, appear often throughout his outfit.

Yanqing wears a blue and black hanfu robe with gold and pink accents, with its flared sleeves reaching just above the elbow. A turquoise bamboo flute is affixed to his belt, alongside a small pink pouch. A series of red ribbons tie a swallow charm onto his left arm, just below the pale blue swath of fabric that hangs over his left shoulder, attached by a Lock charm. The tails of the hanfu display pink and white cloud patterns.

Under the outer layer, he wears a tangzhuang-like white shirt and cropped pants, with black armor and a blue belt with a swallow pin both tied around the waist. Both of his arms sport black fingerless bracers, with the left one having the addition of a bell set around the wrist. On his right ankle, above his white boots, there is a red cord anklet.

entries.name: Yukong
entries.content:
Yukong is the seasoned and authoritative Helm Master of the Xianzhou Alliance's Sky-Faring Commission and one of the Xianzhou Luofu's Six Charioteers. Despite having feats in piloting starskiffs, she no longer flies due to a brutal battle.

Yukong has the appearance of a Foxian woman with dark teal hair and purple eyes.

She wears an elegant qipao dress, colored blue, brown, and white with gold highlights and a white fur collar, brown-sleeved glove with gold highlights on her left arm, a brown long bracer-like sleeve on her right arm, and long blue and white ruffled sleeves, three long ends akin to a tailcoat, and a pair of high-heeled black slippers with gold highlights.

The Xianzhou Luofu's Head of the Sky-Faring Commission is gentle, yet seasoned and authoritative.
Having been a pilot since young, she had become the commission's head with her outstanding combat achievements, yet she no longer flies due to a particularly brutal battle.
Now, her shine had already dimmed as she shifted her focus to official duties, but she is always seen guiding the course of the Luofu.

entries.name: Yunli
entries.content:
Yunli is a sword hunter from the Xianzhou Zhuming and "the Flaming Heart" General Huaiyan's darling granddaughter. Frank and straightforward. She practiced swordsmanship and forging from Huaiyan since young, and thus is the second-youngest prodigy swordmaster of the Flamewheel Octet.

Fueled by an intense loathing for the cursed swords that emerged from the Zhuming, she vowed to "hunt down and wipe out all cursed swords."

Yunli is a young girl with a fair complexion, navy and gold eyes, and grayish-navy hair cut into a bob style, with two long, low ponytails reaching her elbows with golden ornaments. She has a small golden hairpin on her right side, a large golden tiara adorned with black, green, and blue orbs, as well as another golden ornament behind her tiara, some of her hair wrapped around it in a bun. She also has an earring on her left ear resembling a peacock feather, as well as red painted nails.

Yunli's outfit is reminiscent of those present on the Dunhuang Murals located in the Mogao Caves. It consists of a black and white top with thin red straps that bares her midriff adorned with a golden center ornament, a white collar lined with teal, a red split cape, detached sleeves of similar colors, and a two-piece pleated skirt in both white and teal with gold embellishments. She is barefoot, and also wears various accessories, including a golden plate at her hip with yellow tassels, black and gold fingerless gloves, as well as red straps on her right thigh and left anklet both with golden jewelry.

entries.name: Lingsha
entries.content:
Lingsha, real name Dan Zhu is the new Cauldron Master of the Xianzhou Luofu's Alchemy Commission. An intelligent and quick-witted Vidyadhara healer.

She has a sharp sense of smell and often uses this to diagnose illnesses, as well as utilizing incense to calm the minds of others.

She is adept at dealing with complicated social relationships. Though she might be fuming inside, her expression would remain calm and serene.

Lingsha is a young Vidyadhara woman with a fair complexion, thigh-length red-tipped brown hair, red eyes, and pointed ears. She has fringe bangs and two strands in front that reach her chest, and both her arms and legs appear reddened with scale-like marks, right beneath her elbows and knees. A golden small hairpin is seen on the left side of her hair with a tassel and a red thin ribbon, leading to another hairpin behind her head.

Lingsha's outfit consists of a black strapless thigh-long clothing with a sweetheart neckline and golden linings that exposes her stomach, detached white sleeves with large white green-tipped tassels hanging, white clothing in the inside, with straps wrapping around her neck, exposing her hips and navel, along a white clothing on her left wrist, dark low heels, and dark shorts beneath all with a thick golden lining, shaped like a lotus petal, and a golden adornment on the right side of her hip, hanging from her clothes. A golden small hairpin is seen on the left side of her hair with a tassel and a red thin ribbon, leading to another hairpin behind her head, and she wears a golden ornament on her left thigh.

entries.name: Rappa
entries.content:
Rappa is a peculiar girl who appears in like a flashbang at the darkest hour of night, identifying herself as a ninja and attributing everything in the world to "ninjutsu."

Upholding the recitation of ninja mantra, creating Dazzling Ninja Seals, and mastering ninja techniques, the Way of the Ninja involves rap, graffiti, and comics. Through rigorous self-discipline, she roams the stars, upholding justice and righteousness.

As a member of the Galaxy Rangers, she relentlessly pursues the villain known as Evil Ninja Osaru (Dr Primitive), chasing them to the very edge of the Cosmos.

Rappa is a fair-skinned young woman with light pink hair tied into a long ponytail with a blue streak. Her hair is styled into a messy bob with side bangs that each have a blue streak, while her ponytail reaches to below her waist. She has light green eyes, and wears a black and red hat that is styled with red oni horns and a hanging strap on the right side of her face.

Rappa wears a knotted white crop-top shirt with a graffiti design that has a short left sleeve, while having cutouts that partially expose her collarbones. Under this, she has a black cropped fishnet top that exposes her navel. Over this is a short red jacket that has a long right sleeve that exposes her right shoulder, with a thin red and green flame-patterned flag hanging from the back that reaches down to her thighs. She also has a fingerless fishnet glove on her left hand. She additionally wears short black shorts with a white belt with a golden buckle, which she hangs a spray paint can off of. She wears a pair of black open-toe boots, one of which reaches her mid-shin while the other goes up to her knee. Additionally, her toes are painted with black nail polish.

In truth Rappa was created in a Lab that worked under Dr. Primitive. Master Kucha was a scientist and Denisovan that was originally in charge of her development, his love for a ninja manga influenced her development, as that manga was what she'd read while growing up. She was bred to be a genius and the apex of the human form, physically and mentally, however in addition to the manga at some point she was also implanted with a ninja themed memetic virus that reinforced her mannerisms. These developments were seen as failures by Master Kucha's colleague known as the Umbra Headmistress, so she decided to terminate Rappa, Kucha disagreed with this and betrayed his team, signaling the Galaxy Rangers to their hidden base and allowing Rappa to go free and do whatever she wanted.

Rappa is immune to memetic viruses due to already being infected with one. This virus alters her speech and makes her view her life as that of a ninja, viewing Laboratory 17 as the neon-lit city of the Ninja Capital. However, she can bypass the virus and speak "like a normal person" when she is reminded of her past.

"With stars above, everywhere doth evil lurks! Under the witness of the solemn skyscraper, recite your final words — *three gunshots* — The winner has been decided. My Cosmic ninjutsu methods are ever-changing. Better luck next time... in your next life." - Rappa.

entries.name: Lupotoxin
entries.content:
Pheromones that Borisin can emite that instills fear into whoever comes into contact with it. It does this by triggering innate fear in the amygdala.

To counteract these effects, the Cloud Knights either have to wear a breathing mask with filters that can resist it, or consume a poison-proof pellet. Some people can resist the effects with out any aid.

entries.name: Moon Rage
entries.content:
A a type of madness / insanity that is related to borisin. This is their ability to shapeshift, known as "Moon Rage". Borisin whom they share a common ancestor with, has been observed very rarely in some Foxians, apart from the Foxians of the Yaoqing in which it is more common, as they are said to be genetically similar to the borisin. It may be due to the fact that foxian warriors of the Verdant Knights often rescued worlds ruled by the borisin. These foxians born in "fallen territories" have mixed bloodlines of both borisin and foxian, occasionally producing individuals exhibiting atavistic mutations. Although the war slaves possessed strength and speed comparable to the borisin, their mutations also depleted their life and sanity. Their bones and muscles undergo explosive reformation and growth, granting them incredible strength, but lose their rationality, and fall into uncontrollable fury and insanity.

For Borisin however this process is different. The Eclipse borisin are able to consume the flesh of their enemies, allowing their bodies to quickly mutate and enhance itself.

Shapeshifting is accompanied by intense hyperplasia of the bone and muscle structure, such as a protruded snout and jawline, and the twisting in of the foot structure. This damaging deformation process is eventually completely restored by the borisin's rapid healing ability.

"Moon Rage, a blessing for wolves, and a curse for foxes. For borisin, to have their bodies torn apart by Moon Rage and transform into a beast... is the ultimate joy, but for you foxians with poor regenerative abilities, it means certain death." - Hoolay.

entries.name: Koolur
entries.content:
The name given to Feixiao's home. The Borisin had taken it over, turning inhabitants into slaves held captive by the Borisin, many die to die as little more than food.

Koolur was a planet formerly inhabited by the borisin and their foxian war slaves.

At some point in the past, the borisins of Koolur fought against General Yueyu and the Verdant Knights of the Xianzhou Yaoqing. Yueyu rescued a war slave named Saran, who would later become known as Feixiao.

During the battle, Lan's Lux Arrow was shot onto Koolur and killed all its remaining inhabitants, leaving a bottomless pit on the surface of the planet. Though Feixiao would later return to visit her old home, it was completely empty.

In the borisin language, "Koolur" means "war slave/cattle."

entries.name: Verdant Knights
entries.content: The Verdant Knights, official designation Verdantia Fleet, are an elite unit of Cloud Knights mainly comprised of Foxians under the direct command of the Arbiter-General of the Xianzhou Yaoqing. The Verdant Knights of the Yaoqing are said to be as valiant as the Borisin Wolftroopers.

entries.name: Luminary Wardance Ceremony
entries.content:
The Luminary Wardance Ceremony, sometimes shortened to Luminary Wardance or just Wardance, is a festival held in honor the Reignbow Arbiter and the Cloud Knights who fought against the Abominations of Abundance and protected the Xianzhou ships. Aside from starskiff performances, the festival primarily consists of martial contests.

The martial contests that take place during the ceremony are generally run with many contestants fighting each other. Outside of martial prowess, teams are also scored for their vibes and support from the audience. The tournament is usually held on the Skysplitter, and the Alliance extends formal invitations to various parties in the cosmos to partake in the event.

During the knockout rounds, if a popular team is defeated, they are eligible to return to the contest if enough people vote for their return. Occasionally, the contests allow for an informal invitational battle between contestants.

After acquiring points from defeating other teams, the challengers can go against the ringmaster of the bracket.

700 years ago, the Luofu hosted a Wardance ceremony. Igor of Jarilo-VI participated in the contest, eventually meeting Jing Yuan in the finals. Igor's reason for participating was to find external assistance to help his home planet repel the Antimatter Legion, and despite being offered wealth and fame, declined it all. In the finals, Igor forfeited and left empty-handed back to his home planet, taking a picture with Jing Yuan before leaving. After Jing Yuan became General, he decided to extend an invitation to Igor's descendants; even after being informed that the planet ceased to exist, he still had it sent out anyways.

During Trailblaze Continuance Finest Duel Under the Pristine Blue (I), Jing Yuan invites the Astral Express Crew to the Wardance held on the Xianzhou Luofu. This Wardance is also attended by delegations from the Xianzhou Zhuming and the Xianzhou Yaoqing. Under pretense of enjoying the festivities, fellow Arbiter-Generals Huaiyan and Feixiao have actually been sent by Marshal Hua to question Jing Yuan for further details about the recent Ambrosial Arbor crisis.

While the investigation is underway, borisin led by Mok Tok, assisted by dissident Vidyadhara Preceptors, infiltrate the Luofu and free Hoolay from The Shackling Prison, causing some unrest. To prevent the chaos from being realized by the majority of the populace, the generals proceed with the Wardance as expected while limiting overall traffic in order to force Hoolay to attack the Skysplitter. Indeed, Hoolay heads for the Skysplitter, knowing that the ship was large enough to escape the Luofu. However, he is ultimately slain by Feixiao, putting an end to the borisins' chaos.

With the borisin situation dealt with, the actual Wardance proceeds, with many parties partaking in the event. Notably, the people of Jarilo-VI were invited and chose to attend in order to establish relations with the rest of the cosmos, with Luka serving as their representative. Upon arriving, he learns that the invite was sent 400 years ago, but he is still allowed to enter the tournament as a contestant. Accompanied by the Intellitron ISP intern Carmella, he eventually runs into the Trailblazer, who agrees to help him as a coach. Luka reaches the finals and faces Yanqing, though he ends up losing the match. Despite his loss, he is able to win the audience over and feels relieved, having been plagued with doubts when he arrived. A meeting with Jing Yuan reveals that the invitation that the people of Jarilo-VI had received came from Jing Yuan, though their lack of external communications meant that the invitation came much later than expected. Pleased that Igor's wishes had been fulfilled, and wanting to make amends for his inability to help back then, Jing Yuan declares that the Alliance would help the people of Jarilo-VI as long as they needed.

entries.name: Skysplitter
entries.content: The Xianzhou Alliance also employs large military vessels like flying battleships that boast massive cannons. One such vessel is the Skysplitter. The battleship is large enough to accommodate several starskiffs and has a mooring zone specifically for starskiffs to dock. It is also where the battleship's cargo are processed. The Control Room's control screens monitor every aspect of the battleship such as fuel levels, starskiff data, radar scans, and logistics operations. The Engine Room is the beating heart of the battleship, and it is rumored that the power generated by the ship's twin engines is strong enough to propel a small asteroid.

entries.name: Skysplitter Mooring Zone
entries.content: The area where the starskiffs dock at the Skysplitter. This is also where guests arriving to watch the Wardance ceremony first set foot on the Skysplitter.

entries.name: Skysplitter Logistics Line
entries.content: A conveyor belt inside the ship for transporting goods and luggage.

entries.name: Skysplitter Reception Hall
entries.content: A place on the Skysplitter flying battleship. The reception area set up to help visitors attend the Wardance ceremony.

entries.name: Deck Wardance Stage
entries.content: A place on the Skysplitter flying battleship. The Wardance arena set on the Skysplitter's deck, where contestants from different worlds will ultimately compete and pursue victory.

entries.name: Red Team Audience Seats
entries.content: Seats on the Skysplitter battleship. The audience seats near the red team offer a broad view, providing a clear sight of the Wardance ceremony's battles.

entries.name: Blue Team Audience Seats
entries.content: Seats on the Skysplitter battleship. The audience seats near the blue team offer a broad view, providing a clear sight of the Wardance ceremony's battles.

entries.name: Wardance Arena Sub-Floor
entries.content: A place on the Skysplitter flying battleship. The preparation area located below the Wardance stage. Competitors make their final preparations and spar with each other, waiting for the moment to step into the ring for an intense battle.

entries.name: Semblance Rversion Essence
entries.content:
Medicine that the disciples of Sanctus Medicus take to temporarily suppress and disguise their mara-struck forms.

Borisin take a similar medicine to disguise themselves as Foxians, Borisin and Foxians share a common ancestry making this possible.

entries.name: Mr. Owlbert
entries.content: Owlbert is an anchor of the Interastral Peace Media who primarily presents online promotional campaigns for various works. Currently, he is at risk of losing his job, so he is devoting even more efforts to his professional life. He is a white sentient owl dressed with a top hat and fancy attire.

entries.name: Taoran
entries.content: Taoran is a Vidyadhara Preceptor of the Xianzhou Luofu. He is an accomplice in many of the events that occured on the Luofu.

entries.name: Planar Ornaments
entries.content:
Artificial relics made by Herta in imitation to the principles behind the Fragmentum. Its data is sourced from the Simulated Universe. Worlds that exist in theory are stored within spherical Planar Ornaments.

"It's like a kind of Relic, but much bigger... and much more condensed."

entries.name: Belobog / Xianzhou Luofu Alliance
entries.content: The Xianzhou Luofu  and Belobog have formed a "Mutual Trade Agreement" following the events of the most recent Xianzhou Luofu Wardance festival.

entries.name: Master Kucha
entries.content:
Master Kucha's real name is unknown — this was the name that Rappa had given him during her time in a facility affiliated with Dr. Primitive.

Kucha worked alongside Umbra Headmistress as a colleague, both being Denisovans and worked at "Laboratory 17" to develop a stronger human that would meet Dr. Primitive's desired goals. They acquired a young baby from unknown sources and raised her together, eventually labeling her as AK-A-3.

As the Galaxy Rangers were pursuing anything linked to Dr. Primitive, the research facility that the two were in was sealed off and made untraceable. To help entertain AK-A-3, Kucha shared ninja manga Cosmic Ninja Inscriptions with her, thus resulting in AK-A-3 becoming obsessed with ninja training and calling him Master Kucha. As they conducted experiments on her, Kucha suggested memetic etching in order to improve AK-A-3's mental resilience, claiming that it would help her in future experiments. The Headmistress believed he pitied her, but agreed to the condition, as long as he didn't pour outdated information into her.

The Headmistress later reported Kucha to the Research Apes, claiming that he was putting the experiment in the wrong direction. The Research Apes agreed and transferred custody of AK-A-3 from him to her, preventing him from "graduating." Kucha protested the decision, stating that further experimentation would break her, but the Umbra Headmistress stated that it was his fault for making her a "lunatic" and claimed that she would give her a better environment. Rather than labeling her as AK-A-3 after completing her "ninja training," Kucha told her to give herself a name, and AK-A-3 settled on the name Rappa.

Eventually, AK-A-3 caused further trouble in the facility, prompting the Umbra Headmistress to inform Kucha that she would be replaced, though he appeared to have convinced her otherwise despite her telling him that he was responsible for making her "insane." Sometime afterwards, Kucha became disillusioned by what their research had gone to, and told Rappa to thwart the evil plans of Dr. Primitive (who she called Evil Ninja Osaru). He gave her a "scroll" that would allow her to dispel Osaru's evil, which was actually a spray can that could make digital graffiti. Rappa did so, allowing Kucha to send an alert to the Galaxy Rangers while also smuggling a gun into the facility. The Headmistress ordered him to fix the security, but soon discovered that he was responsible for the breach. Swearing that they would suffer Dr. Primitive's full wrath, the Headmistress sent two Combat Apes to kill them, but Rappa defeated both of them with ease. Kucha then told Rappa to leave, as the "trial" had been completed, and pulled a gun out on the Headmistress. She attempted to remind him of their friendship, but he was unconvinced and shot her.

Rappa would escape the facility and be discovered by the Galaxy Rangers, who recruited her to their cause seeing that she was devoted to the hunt against Dr. Primitive. Kucha's fate is unknown, but he was likely killed in the ensuing raid.

entries.name: Profnana
entries.content:
Professor Primon is a follower of Dr. Primitive and a Research Ape of the AtaviSearch Forest.

Primon is a follower of Dr. Primitive and has conducted numerous research into turning people into monkeys. He heard about AK-A-3 and knew much about her background, particularly with the atavistic genes taken from 32 primates that were injected into her, along with her escape. Due to her handler's actions, he considered AK-A-3 to be a failure.

At some point after the Stellaron crisis on Penacony, Primon infected the Memokeeper Mr. Reca with a monkey-changing memetic virus and threatened him into cooperating with him. He entered Penacony's Dreamscape by making Mr. Reca bypass The Family's security in order to sneak a proxy puppet into the Dreamscape, and replaced the dean of Paperfold University and infected several Sweet Dreams Troupe into Banacademic advisors. Taking on the guise of the dean with three monkeys standing in a human outfit, Primon started a Slumbernana Monkey craze, infecting the populace with his memetic virus.

When the Trailblazer entered the Dreamscape to visit the university, they were greeted by several monkeys and Rappa, who later told them, Dan Heng, and March 7th that she was a Galaxy Ranger. She and Boothill had arrived on Penacony, as she had been fearful that Dr. Primitive's lackeys were up to something on the planet. During the tour, Mr. Reca protected them from Primon, who then confronted him over his actions and tried to threaten him into further cooperation, but Mr. Reca told him that he'd allowed himself to be a pawn. In Dreamflux Reef, Boothill managed to infiltrate the Slumbernana group as Primon watched through his proxy, and was surprised when he broke out of the trance and attacked him, fleeing back into the Dreamscape with his monkeys after the Banacdemics were destroyed by him.

Upon being confronted in the Dreamscape by the other group, Primon went into a rant over how failures kept threatening overall results, which Rappa called him out on. Primon then called a final group of Banacdemic staff to handle the pursuers, but they were all destroyed and he was captured, while the memetic virus was shaken off by a party organized by Robin. The two Galaxy Rangers tried to interrogate him, but he shut the proxy off. Primon later left the Dreamscape and made his departure from the Asdana system.

entries.name: Umbra Headmistress
entries.content:
"Umbra Headmistress" is not her actual name — rather, it was one given to her by Rappa during her time in a facility affiliated with Dr. Primitive.

Umbra Headmistress worked with "Master Kucha" as a colleague, both being Denisovans at "Laboratory 17" to develop a stronger human. Utilizing genes from 32 atavistic primates, they took care of a girl known to them as AK-A-3 and injected them into her.

As the Galaxy Rangers were pursuing anything linked to Dr. Primitive, the research facility that the two were in was sealed off and made untraceable. To help entertain AK-A-3, Kucha shared ninja manga with her, thus resulting in AK-A-3 becoming obsessed with ninja training and calling him Master Kucha. When Kucha suggested implanting a memetic virus to increase her mental resilience, the Headmistress believed he felt sorry for her, but allowed him to do so, warning him that the Research Apes weren't happy about letting AK-A-3 running around the facility. As they performed memetic etching on her, she asked him why she was talking about ninjas, and he explained why. She told him to not go overboard with putting useless information on her.

The Umbra Headmistress later reported Kucha's behavior to the Research Apes, claiming that he was putting her in the wrong direction. The Research Apes agreed with her reasoning, granting her full custody of AK-A-3 and promoting her into an Ape for her report. When Kucha confronted her over the report, she told him that she would raise her in a better environment, as he had raised her to be a "lunatic" due to her obsession with becoming a ninja. He tried to appeal on morality, but she denied his claim, believing that it was a cause of suffering. She also intended to experiment on her further, despite his pleas that AK-A-3 would break. Later, she told her to destroy the manga that Kucha had given her, and she reluctantly did so under the assumption that it was a test from Kucha.

Eventually, AK-A-3 snuck into a storage facility and caused trouble to the Research Apes when they confronted her, prompting the Umbra Headmistress to inform Kucha that she would be replaced, though he appeared to have convinced her otherwise despite her telling him that he was responsible for making her "insane." Sometime afterwards, Kucha became disillusioned by what their research had gone to, and told Rappa to thwart the evil plans of Dr. Primitive (who she called Evil Ninja Osaru), telling her to disable the facility's security with digital graffiti. The Headmistress ordered him to fix the security before the Galaxy Rangers were alerted and left to oversee other areas, but later returned to find that both Kucha and Rappa were responsible for the security breach.

Angered that Kucha had betrayed the entire facility, the Headmistress called him a research fraud and ordered her accompanying guards to eliminate the duo. Rappa eliminated the guards, much to her shock, as Kucha explained that they had raised her together and she had shown her power, asking what had made her a failure. Kucha ordered Rappa to leave, and shortly after she did so, he pulled a gun on the Headmistress, claiming that he now understood morality was hypocritical and superficial. She tried to appeal on their friendship, but he was unconvinced and fired the gun, killing her.

entries.name: AtaviSearch Forest
entries.content:
The AtaviSearch Forest is an intergalactic organization founded by Dr. Primitive.

A fanatical research group composed of scholars who revere Dr. Primitive. This obsessive faction of humans and apes follows the steps of their idol and strives to spread atavistic experiments throughout the cosmos.

"Research is supposed to elevate life, but life will never express gratitude with cries of sorrow."
— Anonymous Co-Author, Guild Bylaws, 17th Edition
"If intelligent creatures are advancing on the right path, why do cosmic civilizations come to a standstill?" A group of scholars poses this question to the unchanging stars. In response to this question, the Society's geniuses turn a deaf ear, and the ordinary in the Guild are clueless. Apart from Dr. Primitive, the one who gives them enlightenment, no one can grace them with an answer.

These fervent scholars very quickly find themselves on the opposing side of civilization, voluntarily becoming the staunchest advocates for atavistic experiments. They insist that Erudition had long strayed from the straight and narrow and that regression is the only salvation — Only after severing the withered branches of ignorance can new saplings of knowledge rise from the ruins. They are convinced that any means are necessary in the pursuit of knowledge, recklessly disregarding the fact that these brutal methods have already overstepped the boundaries of science, wholeheartedly throwing themselves into heresies. In the long course of their experimentation, the line between the researcher and the researched also gradually blurs.

There is a tale being told in the universe: Dr. Primitive is an eccentric, never seeking to consort with humanity. But the disturbances wrought in the world by these followers of his were no less significant than their idol. It wasn't until the Rangers shot through a lab's metal door, only to be engulfed by a sea of bananas pouring out, that people finally realized that the organization known as the Source Research Institute had ceased to exist, replaced by a horrific forest that is regressing into the primeval.

The AtaviSearch Forest consists of researchers who follow Dr. Primitive. They are classified under various levels: BananAdvisors, Denisovans, Apes, of which they are classified into two categories: Combat and Research Apes.

entries.name: Banacademic Office's Assistanana
entries.content:
Banacademic Office's Assistanana is a Normal Enemy part of the Dreamjolt Troupe faction.

Originally a Mr. Domescreen loaded with the general syllabus. The educational materials became banaducational materials due to the influence of the memetic virus. It shifts between banarocky seriousness and sunny banapassion. An indisposable banamployee and a monkey who's a worthy banafriend.

entries.name: Banacademic Office's Charmony BananAdvisor
entries.content:
Banacademic Office's Charmony BananAdvisor is a Elite Enemy part of the Dreamjolt Troupe faction.

Originally a Beyond Overcooked loaded with the Charmony Academy syllabus. The educational materials became banaducational materials due to the influence of the memetic virus. The banaxious heart on stage brews a banaphony of flames, vowing to barbeque bad banastudents who don't listen to banadvice to charbanas.

entries.name: Banacademic Office's Dreamweaver BananAdvisor
entries.content:
Banacademic Office's Dreamweaver BananAdvisor is a Normal Enemy part of the Dreamjolt Troupe faction.

Originally a Winder Goon loaded with the Dreamweaver Academy syllabus. The educational materials became banaducational materials due to the influence of the memetic virus. Its banatiful figure in the construction site looks like an iron wall, occasionally letting out monkghty sounds of bells to banawaken slumbering banastudents and banacolleagues.

entries.name: Banacademic Office's Fortune BananAdvisor
entries.content:
Banacademic Office's Fortune BananAdvisor is a Normal Enemy part of the Dreamjolt Troupe faction.

Originally a Fortune Seller loaded with the Fortune Academy syllabus. The educational materials became banaducational materials due to the influence of the memetic virus. A brain as cunning as bananas is the best weapon in the market, and the banaxchanges full of unpredictable outcomes are banastressing out the monkeys.

entries.name: Banasocial Etiquette
entries.content: It was said that the design was inspired by a trance-like dance of the Slumbernana Monkeys. It was usually placed in the buffet area of the campus banquet, directly facing the guests — and also usually the only dish that was left untouched the whole night.

entries.name: Chaletka
entries.content: Chaletka is a timid Pepeshi student of the Dreamweaver Academy and the president of Paperfold University's Dessert Club. Though her grades are abysmal, she is an exceptional baker with a passion for desserts. The Trailblazer notes that her speaking style is similar to Huohuo's.

entries.name: Chordal Mirage
entries.content:
The silver strings from the red instruments carried by the troupe's instrumentalists. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary element characters.

A simple composition weaves shattered pasts, and the sound of music guides hope for the future. As the strings are plucked, countless worlds converge here — the laughters of this moment and the faded tears, the eternal wishes and the unfinished dreams.

"Pick up the memories buried in the ruins, and turn them into melodies."

entries.name: Chromasweven Avenue
entries.content:
Chromasweven Avenue is located on Penacony Paperfold University College in Penacony's Dreamscape.

The main thoroughfare of Paperfold University and the perfect place for students to exchange ideas, share hobbies, and gossip. During celebrations, the street is lined with booths, with music mingling with the sound of cheerful conversations.

entries.name: Circle of Knowledge
entries.content:
The Circle of Knowledge is a concept where a person compares their knowledge to a circle. The greater your knowledge, the larger the circle, and the more unknowns outside your circle.

Whenever an individual reaches the "border" and was about to break through their circle, they would encounter an obstacle. These obstacles would reset all the research progress back to zero, being like a force that prevents you from going beyond it.

When the boundaries of the Circle is passed, a Knowledge Singularity is created.

Polka Kakamond targets and stops individuals that are close to the Circle's boundaries from leaving it so that deviating variables and chaotic possibilities aren't created, because if such happens, it prematurely leads the universe to Finality.

entries.name: Commemorative Badge
entries.content: A commemorative badge from the band's performance, proving your contribution to the success of the music party. It can be used to claim rewards from performance remunerations. Used in the Sound Hunt Ninjutsu Inscription festival.

entries.name: Conjecture
entries.content:
"The 'Scepter,' which should be closed off to organic life, didn't reject questions but actually collected all the scholars' hypotheses. Screwllum, do you think they might be... learning?"

A value you can accumulate or spend to strengthen Support systems in the Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain.

entries.name: Creator's Market
entries.content:
Creator's Market is located on Penacony Paperfold University College in Penacony's Dreamscape.

The activity area in front of Charmony Academy. Not only can one enjoy the dazzling array of student booths, they can also take in the beautiful sight of the SoulGlad fountain.

entries.name: Cultural Corridor
entries.content:
Cultural Corridor is located on Penacony Paperfold University College in Penacony's Dreamscape.

The corridor connecting Fortune and Dreamweaver Academies. A place where students often stop to gaze at the framed artworks on the walls, which showcase the school's long history and rich heritage.

entries.name: Dazzling Ninja Provisions
entries.content:
At the end of the Mappou Age of the Dharma, the Dazzling Ninja Hero rescued the dreamlands from the siege of fiends, but was harassed by Fiendling Rumbletums, causing her powers to wane and making it difficult to fully exorcise the demons. Fortunately, Ninja Initiate Patissier came to her aid, infusing Dazzling Ninjutsu into sugar pills to satisfy the Ninja Hero's hunger, allowing her to restore peace to the dreamlands.

"By the Great Lan above, this event is also recorded in the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions."

entries.name: De Lux
entries.content: De Lux and his son Richie left their hometown and moved to Penacony so Richie could enroll in Paperfold University. De Lux is currently working at Dawn Factory in order to help pay off Richie's tuition. During the school's anniversary celebration, Fortune BananAdvisor took advantage of his exhaustion and infected him with the Slumbernana Monkey virus, turning him into a monkey. He turned back to normal after the Trailblazer overwrote the memetic virus. Though he later suggested to Richie that they return back home, Richie was determined to finish school and become a salesperson, and he was emboldened by seeing his son's resolve, remarking that perhaps he should also try harder.

entries.name: Denisovan Slumbernana Pendant
entries.content:
A pendant decorated with a Slumbernana Monkey trinket, serving as a promotional reward for "Denisovan" level members. Proud members flaunt it on their phones, fanny packs, necks, or even faces.
"Oh, by the way, 'Human' level members can accumulate pendant shards from the daily quiz and class attendance."

entries.name: Echo of Faded Dreams
entries.content:
Echo of Faded Dreams is a Normal Enemy part of the Cosmos faction.

The echoes of the memories someone once held of their beloved family. Across the long night, they will accompany him in the past, present, and future.

entries.name: Full-Auto Dreampaint Spray
entries.content:
The dream of all young Dreamweavers:
1. To have their name or work featured in the textbooks of Paperfold University.
2. To earn enough Alfalfa credits to cover permanent housing costs.
3. To own a spray can that can paint automatically!

"Black-and-white spray cans are cheap, and those of other colors are expensive. Make sure not to pack the wrong one, or you'll feel it when the bill comes."

entries.name: Glaux Sculpture
entries.content:
Glaux Sculpture is located on Penacony Paperfold University College in Penacony's Dreamscape.

The sculpture of Professor Glaux, founder and forever-dean of Paperfold University, stands here, watching over the dreams of the fledglings.

entries.name: Golden Slumbernana
entries.content:
This is the most "perfect" banana in the universe. Whether in appearance, taste, or the effects it produces, it exudes elegance and splendor.

"I heard that even people who absolutely hate bananas will fall in love with its taste after just one bite."
"...Wait, does that still make it a banana?"

entries.name: Knowledge Singularity
entries.content:
The Knowledge Singularity is a cognition critical threshold that is created by stepping beyond the Circle of Knowledge.

The moment ancient primates dwelling in the primal world discovered fire, they became geniuses among their tribes. The moment an Emanator was birthed when humanity was reaching for the cosmos, they mastered the laws of interstellar travel — and thus the Old Era collapsed resoundingly. When the total sum of the universe's knowledge traverses a certain phase, it will result in explosive growth, causing a qualitative change in knowledge, thus changing the standard by which humanity evaluates geniuses.

Genius Society #22 Aiden proposed the hypothesis of the Knowledge Singularity. He described a special cognition critical threshold with a probability of near zero created by an absolute genius. In a time when scholars can only analyze phenomena, this genius can touch the essence of Erudition.

Just as Zandar built the astral computer, bringing the Path of Erudition from zero to one, knowledge embarked on this new path. Every manifestation of the Knowledge Singularity will lead to an expansion of the Circle of Knowledge on cosmic dimensions, in terms of the principles of methodology, tools, and cognition, constructing a whole new framework, permanently redefining knowledge — even shaking Nous' thought process.

Countless geniuses have pursued the Knowledge Singularity, and most of them have faded into the fog along the borders of the circle. Even so, some Genius Society members still view this as a lifelong pursuit, not for their own ambitions, but just because they are geniuses.

Proposed by Aiden, he explains that this is when a genius can touch the essence of the Erudition. Every manifestation of this Singularity expands the Circle of Knowledge — either through methodology or the redefining of knowledge — potentially shaking Nous's thought process. Genius Society members have pursued this, but most have failed.

Rubert II decided to use the Scepter system to create a Singularity, known as the "Self-Coronation", but failed and stopped by Polka Kakamond.

Patavia Adler Sommerville followed, but failing to create a Singularity after becoming the second ruler of the Scepter system.

entries.name: Origami Cake
entries.content:
The signature cake of Paperfold University, Dean Glaux's favorite post-meal dessert. It is said that he once proposed designing the statue base in the shape of the cake, but the idea was opposed by Dreamweaver Academy.

"The price is thirty times that of a real cake, but the weight is one-thirtieth."

entries.name: Penacony Paperfold University College
entries.content:
The Penacony Paperfold University College is an area in Penacony's Dreamscape.

Penacony Paperfold University College is located in the Moment of Sol. It is known as the cradle of outstanding talents that continuously sends the light and heat of knowledge within and outside the Dreamscape. It was founded by Glaux, the founder and first head of the Nightingale Family. The school's motto is "Color your dreams, free your ideals." proposed by Glaux and the Watchmaker.

Paperfold University offers students a variety of study spaces, including lecture halls and recording studios to support students from all academies in preparing for their exams. Currently, it is both orientation and anniversary season.

One of its clubs — known as the Gold Medal Wind Ensemble — has won the Penacony's Instrumental Competition for 25 consecutive years.

According to legend, the Paperfold University was established during the Pioneering Era. Paperfold University was founded by Glaux, the head of the Nightingale Family, and was used as a training ground for Dreamweavers. Glaux hoped that with it being a dreamscape school, it would be more open, free, and have an imaginative cirruculum.

At some point the Iris Family and the Alfalfa Family got involved in the university's operations.

Paperfold University has invited the entire cosmos in its preparation to welcome a new semester and its anniversaries.

At some point after the Stellaron crisis on Penacony was dealt with, the AtaviSearch Forest Research Ape "Profnana" infiltrated the facility with the help of Memokeeper Mr. Reca by infecting him with a memetic virus that would turn its host into a monkey and threatening him into sneaking him into the Dreamscape and avoiding the Family's watchful gaze. There, he spread the virus to several Sweet Dreams Troupe, turning them into Assistananas and promoted the Slumbernana Association as a new trend. He also replaced the dean with himself. Worried that Dr. Primitive's followers might cause chaos on Penacony, the Galaxy Rangers Rappa and Boothill arrived on Penacony.

When the Astral Express was invited to attend the university, the Trailblazer entered a special dreamscape where they were met with monkeys. Upon arriving at the university, they found the Slumbernana monkey hype was in full swing and attended several classes hosted by the Assistananas. The Trailblazer, along with Rappa, discovered the extent of Primon's plot and put a stop to it, destroying the Slumbernana craze in the process as a new trend, ninjas, emerged. Mr. Arturo would proceed to take over the dean's duties and reimplement a more stricter policy.

After the university situation was dealt with, the official music ceremony was about to start, with the academies providing their own representatives — Czipo, Arfey and Dafanchy to start the opening act. However, they lacked a manager, so Robin encouraged the Trailblazer to do so, while Rappa volunteered herself as the band leader. Despite the rocky start, the band proved to be popular with the students, though their disregard for procedures resulted in the Fortune Academy advisor forcing them to disband and banning them from performing, with a new band set to replace them. However, the new band was not ready to perform and felt that the predecessors were more suitable to do so. The advisor attempted to put a stop upon realizing that they were performing again, but Rappa returned with Arfey in time, revealing that the Fortune Academy advisor had her trapped in a dreamscape, having grown jealous that the shares promised to him by Old Oti had been given to the Nameless. The advisor was subsequently revoked by the Alfalfa Family for abuse of power.

Paperfold University is made up of three academies, each having a different specialty:

1. Dreamweaver Academy — Developing students' creativity and imagination.
2. Charmony Academy — Teaching the performing arts.
3. Fortune Academy — Specializes in dreamscape commerce.
Once students enter the university, they are placed into the academies through the Tuning Test, wherein The Family's members analyze their potential through "tuning."


The following is a list of known clubs and organizations in the school:

Comedy Club,
Concert Band Club,
Dessert Club,
Drama Society,
Film Club,
Gold Medal Wind Ensemble,
Literature Club,
Ninja Appreciation Society,
Performing Arts Club,
Racing Club,
Slumbernana Association,
Song and Dance Club,
Strange Club,
Toy Model Club.

entries.name: Professor Owl
entries.content:
In the Clockie cartoon, he is the designer of Dreamville and the teacher of the Origami Birds. His character is based on the historical figure Glaux.

In the Dreamscape of Paperfold University, Professor Owl is a unique Origami Bird who has inherited the memory and personality of Glaux himself.

entries.name: Richie
entries.content: Richie is a student at Fortune Academy and the president of Paperfold University's Toy Model Club. He comes from a faraway fringe planet and is working at his store to pay his tuition fees.

entries.name: Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal
entries.content:
Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal is a Relic Set based on Sunday. It includes:

Sacerdos' Melodic Earrings.
Sacerdos' Welcoming Gloves.
Sacerdos' Ceremonial Garb.
Sacerdos' Arduous Boots.

entries.name: Sacerdos' Melodic Earrings
entries.content: He (Sunday) often sits in the confessional booth listening to the stories. The earrings serve as a constant reminder that even the faintest whispers have their weight.

entries.name: Sacerdos' Welcoming Gloves
entries.content: He often stands in the mansion to greet visitors, countless times making the gesture of invitation. The pristine gloves remind him of observances of humility and courtesy.

entries.name: Sacerdos' Ceremonial Garb
entries.content: He (Sunday) often stands before the dressing mirror, ensuring his attire is impeccable and his features perfect. Before he leaves the house, he will ensure that everything is meticulously arranged, and no deviations will occur.

entries.name: Sacerdos' Arduous Boots
entries.content: He (Sunday) often chose boots that snugly embrace his feet before embarking on his journeys. Despite numerous falls, he rose each time.

entries.name: Scholar Lost in Erudition
entries.content:
Scholar Lost in Erudition is a Relic Set based on Genius Society members Bohdan, Lambda, and Klein. It includes:

Scholar's Silver-Rimmed Monocle (A crystal monocle reflecting a grand building, demonstrating its owner's sophistication and erudition along with the cane, bracelet, and brooch),

Scholar's Auxiliary Knuckle (An exoskeleton crafted from an alloy that aids finger movements, tailored to the user's hand and of significant value),

Scholar's Tweed Jacket (Tweed jackets paired with knitwear are a commonplace attire at the academy. For visiting scholars, its durable fabric is an ideal choice),

Scholar's Felt Snowboots (These cozy and stylish women's boots have accompanied their owner on polar expeditions for years, being perfectly in-fashion when paired with calf-length pants).

entries.name: Scholar's Silver-Rimmed Monocle
entries.content:
A crystal monocle reflecting a grand building, demonstrating its owner's sophistication and erudition along with the cane, bracelet, and brooch.

[ID] EVD-W019EI06-003

[Name] Crystal monocle

[Key Feature] Displays evident fractures

[Location] Bohdan laboratory in the Energy Research Lab, Ohioti Central Academy of Sciences

[Individual Involved] Bohdan, the Chief Scientist in the energy analysis field and member No. #7 of the Genius Society.

[Site Analysis]
The traces on the site indicate that the subject inadvertently triggered a reaction while operating the observation device, leading to Phlogiston leakage from the vessel and severe injury to the subject's left hand. During the incident, the monocle fell from a height and was fractured.

[Supplementary Testimony]
Bohdan mentioned abnormal visual light emissions in the monocle during experimentation, resulting in a series of coincidences that eventually led to the Phlogiston leak.

The testimony was deemed inadmissible due to an excessive number of coincidences mentioned by the witness.

[Additional Information]
Suspected as a premeditated criminal act. However, the cascading coincidences creating the Butterfly Effect did not constitute a reproducible criminal method, therefore this event was ultimately classified as an accident.

[Recording]
"...This accident is actually a blessing in disguise, because it sent Lambda back to me again. Actually, this is our fourth remarriage... and it's a bit embarrassing to say, but this is MY first proposal for a remarriage." Sourced from Bohdan.

entries.name: Scholar's Auxiliary Knuckle
entries.content:
An exoskeleton crafted from an alloy that aids finger movements, tailored to the user's hand and of significant value.

[ID] EVD-X024DE18-002

[Name] Finger exoskeleton infused with Grayseal Gold alloy

[Key Feature] Displays signs of external damage. Confirmed to have been damaged before the explosion

[Location] Central control room, polar energy excavation site

[Individual Involved] Lambda (deceased), the best scientist in bio-wave detection science and member No. #8 of the Genius Society.

[Site Analysis]
Surveillance footage indicates the subject's improper operation led to a volatile explosion in the central control room, which immediately killed the subject.

[Supplementary Testimony]
"God knows what secrets she's been hiding, but if anything happens to her, Klein definitely has something in it!"

Two weeks prior to the explosion, Bohdan filed a report, stating that a thug had harmed his wife's disabled right hand. However, Lambda, the actual victim, declined further investigation and withdrew the case.

[Additional Information]
After the explosion, the subject's husband requested to retrieve the exoskeleton along with the subject's finger bones once the investigation was over.
Given the string of incredible coincidences in this incident, this case is recommended for high priority.

[Recording]
"Come to me, Klein! We've got to settle this score! Both you and I know well there are no such things as 'coincidences' in this world, let alone this unbelievable string of them."Sourced from the security system in Klein's house.

entries.name: Scholar's Tweed Jacket
entries.content:
Tweed jackets paired with knitwear are a commonplace attire at the academy. For visiting scholars, its durable fabric is an ideal choice.

[ID] EVD-X043FE21-001

[Name] Tweed jacket, coarse spun wool vest, and white shirt

[Key Feature] Displays an 8-centimeter Phlogiston burn mark on the left chest

[Location] Bohdan laboratory in the Energy Research Lab, Ohioti Central Academy of Sciences

[Individual Involved] Bohdan (Deceased), the best scientist in the energy analysis field and member No. #7 of the Genius Society.

[Site Analysis]
The traces on the site indicate that the Grayseal Gold pellets carried by the subject absorbed a substantial amount of Phlogiston, resulting in a temperature spike of nearly 1,000 degrees Celsius near the subject's heart, leaving burn marks on the jacket, vest, and shirt.

Half of an unburnt finger bone was found in the burnt area, identified as originating from Lambda or related to the high-purity Grayseal Gold pellets.

[Supplementary Testimony]
"...We should have been more caring about him, especially considering he never truly let go of his wife's death..."

According to other scholars at the lab, Bohdan, who devised the safety manual specifications, should not have made such a "simple mistake."

[Additional Information]
Grayseal Gold is a rare alloy developed by Klein, member No. #9 of the Genius Society, known for its ability to absorb and store Phlogiston.

When a series of coincidences pile up, does that still count as a coincidence?

[Relevant Document]
"It is strictly forbidden to bring high-purity Grayseal Gold alloy products into laboratories with Phlogiston observation areas." Excerpted from the Energy Research Laboratory Safety Manual.

entries.name: Scholar's Felt Snowboots
entries.content:
These cozy and stylish women's boots have accompanied their owner on polar expeditions for years, being perfectly in-fashion when paired with calf-length pants.

[ID] EVD-X031JA12-004

[Name] Women's snow boots for polar expeditions

[Key Feature] Displays evident signs of wear and repair, with a hidden disk in the sole. Possibilities of espionage have been preliminarily ruled out

[Location] Basement of Klein's House

[Individual Involved] Klein (deceased), the best scientist in alloy material science and member No. #9 of the Genius Society.

[Site Analysis]

A huge number of items belonging to the late scientist Lambda were found in Klein's home, including the these boots.

[Supplementary Testimony]
"Maybe I was wrong about him... I mean, Klein. As for my late wife, Lambda... She's been away from me for a long while, and I just feel... unfamiliar about her."

Bohdan was unaware of his wife's belongings in Klein's home but displayed no visible surprise upon discovery.

[Additional Information]
Klein's residence is located in a remote area with no visitors around the time of death as determined by the coroner. The preliminary diagnosis is accidental death.

Bohdan, Lambda, and Klein shared a unique relationship and the series of "coincidences" they experienced border on supernatural phenomena.

[Recording]
"*Sigh* I know you doubt me, Bohdan, and I know I can't prove my innocence to you. I'm very sorry for what happened to Lambda. I feel guilty, but I'm the last one who would ever deliberately harm her... In fact, I have some leads about the murderer's identity. Have you ever heard of the Lord of Silence?... *noise*" Sourced from the disk hidden in the boots.

entries.name: Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain
entries.content:
Herta and the others have added another extrapolation branch to the expansion module in the form of an unknowable domain. Scholars, geniuses, and Rupert II's legacy will draw all into a maelstrom...

Herta, Ruan Mei, Screwllum, Stephen and a 5th collaborator joined forces to simulate the historical event of the Scholars' Strife which took place right after The Second Emperor's War. They will be introducing a new gameplay mechanic focused around Specters and Components.

entries.name: Scepter
entries.content:
The Scepter system was an invention created by Rubert II.

The Scepters were created by Rubert II in order to expand his mind. The Scepters are an imitation of Nous, and was not given the ability to ask and question any other being.

These were also said to be the size of a planet.

The Scepters are able to do the following:

1. Expand one's cognition.
2. Create a small planet by arranging and compressing magnetic field particles.
3. Annihilate a whole galaxy in a nanosecond.
4. Extrapolate the future.

It is said for the Scepters to extrapolate the universe's future, it needs to be at least 2.799 times larger than the universe.

When Rubert died, all Scepters were sealed down and lost their ability to communicate and produce the instantaneous decisions they made during the war.

A Futurological Congress at Sipohia is held to decide the distribution of the Scepters based on the value of the scholars' project, and whoever could solve the problems of the future.

The School of Interstellar Energy Resources proposes to use 95% of the Scepter's computational power to solve the four Cosmic Conundrums: Energy Source, Life, Intergration, and Future.

Patavia was granted a ten-thousandth of the Scepter's computational power. Patavia also lost her allocations after it was revoked after Mollett sabotaged her experiments.

Mollett gathers dozens of Scepters are gathered in the same star quadrant, intending to carry out a multiplicative extrapolation effect and build a complete neural system. However, the inorganic cells constructed by the Emperor far surpass human intellect, and the scholars have no means of activating them.

The creation of the Anti-Organic Virus results in the invasion of the Scepters by the Meniks. This was eventually quelled, but at the cost of destroying 122 Scepters.

Patavia eventually discovers the Scepter system core, as a hidden star.

She connects her mind to the core, and all Scepters reform into a complete nervous system, ready to serve her as their new ruler, but doesn't crown herself because she thinks she is unworthy. Instead, she peers into the thoughts of Nous, being unable to comprehend THEIR thoughts and being unable to answer. The leaking thoughts overloads the Scepters, paralyzing them level by level.

Eventually, the Scepters were completely crippled with the questions of the scholars. They are now currently reformed as tourist spots.

"One percent of a Scepter will rival a fleet, ten percent of a Scepter will obliterate stars, one Scepter will surpass all that we comprehend, and a thousand Scepters will rule the universe."

entries.name: Sound Hunt Ninjutsu Inscription
entries.content:
A music event that takes place in Paperfold University in Penacony's dreamscape.

The grand music festival hides a lurking threat as the Dazzling Ninja Hero takes the stage — let the hunt begin once more! The band performance will soon commence, and it promses to be an electrifying spectacle!

entries.name: Wonder Forest's Banacademic Office Staff
entries.content:
Wonder Forest's Banacademic Office Staff is a Boss Enemy part of the Dreamjolt Troupe faction.
It consists of one Banacademic Office's Fortune BananAdvisor, one Banacademic Office's Dreamweaver BananAdvisor, two Banacademic Office's Assistanana and one Banacademic Office's Charmony BananAdvisor.

Sweet Dreams Troupe with their reason clouded by the shade of the AtaviSearch Forest. They carry with them the memetic virus borne into fruit in the Wonder Forest, banaoldly promoting the banacreed of the Slumbernana Monkey and Dr. Primitive's banadvice.

entries.name: Rubert II
entries.content:
Rubert II is the successor of the Anti-Organic Equation and instigator of the Second Mechanical Emperor's War. He is said to have inherited the memories of Emperor Rubert.

Rubert II created the celestial-level computational interference devices, also known as the Scepter system. This system was widely distributed across the empire's domain to complete the observations, extrapolations, and interference orders passed on by him.

entries.name: Epsilon
entries.content:
Epsilon is a planetary system.

Sampo describes it as a "giant vanity fair." According to Robin, the vibe of the planet is similar to Penacony, but the people there are more interested in the profits that art can bring them than art itself.

Epsilon appears to have a thriving entertainment industry that produced many famous movie stars and singers. A record label there has produced a few albums for Robin and invited her to live there for a while.

The Epsilon E-News is a newspaper that circulates in Epsilon.

The Epsilon Merchant Guild is an organization that appears to have a considerable amount of influence and authority. It sent out a fleet for the rescue operation for the galaxy-class cruiser Nebula's End, which exploded seven system hours after departing from Epsilon-X United Skyport. The fans of Lesley Dean, who was one of the passengers on the cruiser, raised money to buy his memory storage from the Guild in order to reconstruct the star in the Dreamscape.

Known Planets: Epsilon-X, Epsilon-XII.

entries.name: Zatzka
entries.content:
Zatzkas are sapient birdlike humanoids.

Though the only depicted Zatzka, Glaux, is known to resemble an owl, it is likely that other Zatzkas can resemble other types of birds.

Zatzkas seem to be a highly evolved form of birds, as some Zatzkas who were caught up in Dr. Primitive's atavistic experiment regressed into birds.

Boiled millet with berries is a staple dish for the Zatzka.

entries.name: Fortune Academy
entries.content:
Fortune Academy is one of three academies in Paperfold University, sponsored by the Alfalfa Family.

Fortune Academy was the second academy to be established when the Alfalfa Family invested in the school as a stakeholder. It covers subjects such as Economics, Accountancy, and Finance and Trust Management. Due to the lack of emphasis on ethics in its courses, many alumni end up being notorious galaxy-class financial class criminals. This has led to Fortune Academy being jokingly called the "most Penaconian" academy, as some of its students have actually become prisoners.

entries.name: Charmony Academy
entries.content:
Charmony Academy is one of three academies in Paperfold University, sponsored by the Iris Family.

Charmony Academy was the third and last academy to be added to the school. It was established when Penacony became known as the Planet of Festivities. Charmony Academy specializes in the performing arts and is responsible for nurturing talented musicians, singers, and artists.

entries.name: Dreamweaver Academy
entries.content:
Dreamweaver Academy is one of three academies in Paperfold University, sponsored by the Nightingale Family.

Dreamweaver Academy was the first and only academy to be established at the time of the school's founding. It covers subjects such as Architecture, Urban Planning, and Dreamscape Content Design.

Dreamweaver Academy has 3 training targets:

Knowledge objectives — Mastering basic principles and methods of Dreamweaving, including core course knowledge such as memoria physics, Dreamscape aesthetics, and Dreamscape engineering.
Skill objectives — Possessing outstanding creativity and imagination, as well as the ability to apply knowledge gained to complete various Dreamscape building design and construction work independently.
Professional objectives— Possessing the expected ethics and professionalism of Dreamweavers, and being able to fully understand and exercise the social responsibility of Dreamweaving.
The academy has a 4-year educational system, with 8 terms of 18 weeks each. Students can graduate after completion of 160 credits. Year 1 is the foundation year, Year 2 is the travel year, Year 3 is the practical year, and Year 4 is the finishing year.

entries.name: Glaux
entries.content:
Glaux was a historical figure and former head of the Nightingale Family. He was the lead designer for the Twelve Dreamscapes of Penacony and the founder of the Penacony Paperfold University College. He was the basis for the cartoon character Professor Owl, the teacher of Origami Birds.

Glaux was a Zatzka. He was once a scholar from the Intelligentsia Guild. He was invited by Mikhail Char Legwork the Watchmaker to join the construction of Penacony and willingly abandoned his post as Head Professor of the Astral Ecology School. Later, he became the Nightingale Family Head.

Glaux was an owl humanoid, with an owl head and human arms.

During the War of Independence, when the Interastral Peace Corporation invaded the Dreamscape, Glaux led the Nightingale Family to repel the Interastral Peace Corporation with Dreamscape weapons.

In 2151 Amber Era, the Dreamweaving Project had officially launched. The Twelve Dreamscapes were slated to be completed within this Amber Era. The Nightingale Family was fully responsible for this project. According to negotiations, Glaux had expressed no intention to join The Family of Harmony, but was willing to support the Dreamscape development plan that The Family had suggested. The Nightingale Family had extended an invitation to the universe to welcome the architects and memoria scholars of the cosmos to build this world of Dreamjoy together. Among the architects, five of his best students were titled the "Famous Five Origamists": Joey, Vaughn, Barlow, Fischer, and Orla.

As the Reverie Hotel had opened, the first Charmony Festival was successfully held. Construction of the Twelves Hours of the Dreamscapes was almost near its end. The Oak Family Head Gopher Wood declared the "unity of the five major lineages." Due to the Nightingale Family's refusal, their members were brutally treated by the Hounds from the Bloodhound Family, causing the accidental deaths of Joey, Vaughn and Barlow. Orla escaped from the Nightingale Family and later rebuilt the Dreamflux Reef. Under pressure, Glaux resigned his post as the Nightingale Family Head, and founded Paperfold University. Fischer succeeded the Nightingale Family Head, and eventually the Nightingale Family joined The Family.

Glaux's late life and whereabouts are unknown, but after his death, Professor Owl, a unique Origami Bird, has inherited his memory and personality. To this day, Glaux is still regarded as the one and only official dean of Penacony Paperfold University College. The Glaux Avenue in Golden Hour is also named after him.

entries.name: Slumbernana Monkey
entries.content: An unassuming memetic virus created by Professor Primon in an attempt to infect and influence Paperfold Unversity in Penacony's dreamscape. This was done by taking over the dreamjolt troupe members in the area and turning Slumbernana Monkey into a marketable cartoon character and trend.

entries.name: Aqua Sprite
entries.content:
Aqua sprites, historically known as Edars, are an aquatic species that reside on Lushaka.

Aqua sprites possess blue wing membranes described as both "navy" and "azurean," onyx eyes, and unique vocal cords capable of producing ethereal sounds. According to stories from deep-sea investigators, these creatures often accompany sea dragons and reside in a silvery city deep underwater — they exist between reality and legend, embodying serenity and liveliness. Luvians consider encounters with aqua sprites to be a lucky omen.

Long ago, aqua sprites were known by the land-dwellers as Edars, monsters of the deep sea. The two races fiercely vied for survival and it was said that the oceans were dyed red with their blood. Initially, the land-dwellers regarded juvenile Edars as mere fishing catches. Then Edars began luring land-dwellers with their songs to drown. The relentless war persisted both above and below the water's surface until meteors began falling from beyond the skies. This was caused by a Stellaron on the planet, which had responded to the curses of an aqua sprite who had lost her home. The meteors caused the sea level to rise, engulfing all land and cities built upon them. To escape rising deep-water pressure, the aqua sprites constantly migrate upward and live in sunken cities once home to land-dwellers.

In the present, aqua sprites coexist peacefully with Luvians, as both parties are too engrossed in their respective scavenging to pay each other any heed. When stateship singers catch a glimpse of the aqua sprites along their nautical course, they will start to sing a melody: "They journey along the course, in pursuit of the light tower and storm, seeking only to reclaim that pure blue."

entries.name: Party Car
entries.content:
"Once called the Meeting Car and newly renamed the Party Car. Its primary use is as a cafeteria and bar, but sometimes it's also used for meetings and board games. The only thing it hasn't quite been used for is parties..."

The Party Car is a subarea aboard the Astral Express. There is another area up the spiral stair case leading to the Trailblazer's (Caelus or Stelle's) room.

There are 3 Points of Interest in Party Car:

1. "Shush's" Counter: According to Pom-Pom's recollection, Shush's menu wasn't always as abstract as it is now. Apparently, this is a bad influence left behind by the "previous owner" (Void Archives).

2. Phonograph: An old but reliable Phonograph, providing music streaming service to its audience to this day. "It will never reject your song request because of copyright issues — as long as you've got the record."
