"Snow City" Aidonia.

Other mentioned city states exist:

Aedes Elysiae,
Aenionus,
Akashic,
Carmitis,
Handak,
Icatus,
Idilia,
Ikaria,
Jericha,
Kadir,
Ladon,
Oleinus,
Sabany,
Stymphalia,
Tretos.

entries.name: Sabany
entries.content:
Sabany was a mentioned city-state in Amphoreus.

Prior to the Black Tide disaster Sabany was one of the vassal cities of Okhema that mainly worshipped Georios, the titan of Earth. The Sabanians were mainly known for their majestic buildings and architecture. When the Black tide reached Sabany, the Sabanian Council of Elders decided to evacuate everyone in the city and take them to Okhema as refuge.

entries.name: Amphoreus
entries.content:
In the beginning, the world was pure chaos until the gods cast down the twelve Coreflames, from which the Titans were born. Three Titans carved the heavens and earth, three wove the threads of fate, three molded life with their hands, and three guided "calamity's gate." Civilization thrived under their guidance until the "heretical black tide" came from beyond the sky. It drove the Titans to madness and the humans to mutual war. A millennium of conflict raged, dimming the Coreflames and bringing an end to the age of the gods. A prophecy foretold that golden blood will "converge into a boiling river that flows to the heroic heirs of this world." It named the Chrysos Heirs, who will "pluck the gods' Coreflames" and once more uphold the world.

Slowly, the cities began to fall, with the "Eternal Holy City" Okhema being the last refuge for humans and their allies to live in. The demigods Aglaea and Tribbie would help guide humanity until their time was over. Aglaea also enforced a strict rule forbidding people to indulge about the skies above, likely related to the prophecy.

After leaving Penacony, Welt considered travelling to either Lushaka or Melustanin, as the Astral Express was dangerously low on fuel due to the prolonged stays in the worlds they had recently been to and could only make two more warps before running completely dry.

Before Welt could initiate a vote with the Trailblazer, March 7th, and Dan Heng, Black Swan suddenly appeared and interrupted the conversation due to overhearing how the Express obtained fuel. She claimed that if they could lay down a track connecting to Amphoreus, they would never have to worry about running out of fuel ever again. Because of this, the crew ultimately votes to go to Amphoreus.

Pom-Pom makes the warp to the location, and Black Swan reveals the planet with her powers.

At the same time, March 7th falls sick for unknown reasons, and both Black Swan and Sunday are unable to find the root cause of her illness. This forces Himeko to use a backup plan that requires the Trailblazer and Dan Heng to go, with Pom-Pom detaching a segment of the Astral Express to use as a safe haven. Everyone else stays behind.

As the two descend onto the planet, they are attacked by an unknown entity and cause their car to crash.

The two discover civilization and eventually signs of life. They meet with the heirs and repel an attack from the Strife Titan Nikador. During their walk around town, they are met by a man named Damionis, who helps them take a photo. However, he also goes through the camera's albums and discovers that life exists beyond the skies, spreading rumors about March 7th.

While the two put an end to the rumors with Mydei's help, Aglaea interrogates the two with the threat of death by Castorice as the Trailblazer had broken their promise with her. They either convince her of their good intentions or are saved by Phainon at the last moment, though she reveals to Tribbie that it was simply a means of building trust, as she knew that Tribbie would have intervened if she was following on her threat.

The Strife Titan Nikador's castle is discovered, and Aglaea sends the Trailblazer, Phainon and Mydei to defeat it.
However, they soon discover that the Titan created a second, indestructible body and is focused to destroy Okhema, prompting Mydei to battle it alone while sending the other two back to inform Aglaea of the development.

Aglaea sends them with Castorice to obtain an audience with the Fate Titan Oronyx, overcoming its trials. Oronyx initially refuses to help, but soon makes a connection with the Trailblazer, who realizes they could help them find "Mother." The deed causes Fuli to gaze upon the Trailblazer, granting them the Path of Remembrance, and Oronyx has the memosprite Mem accompany them.

After going into the past, the Trailblazer and Castorice manage to restore Nikador's true form and defeat it in the present, acquiring its Coreflame. Phainon later undergoes a trial with the Coreflame by himself.

entries.name: Okhema
entries.content:
Okhema is one of the major cities found on Amphoreus.

Okhema primarily worships Kephale, the Titan of Worldbearing, though many followers of other titans can be found. Kephale currently slumbers above the city, holding the Dawn Device which keeps the city safe from the night. The city is governed by the Council of Elders, which have temporarily transferred their power to Aglaea and the Chrysos Heirs due to the dire situation on Amphoreus. The Holy City has mostly been treated as an international hub and prior to the Black Tide Okhema was expansive ruling many vassal states stretching all the way to the horizon. Since the black tide disaster, The Holy City has since become a sanctuary for people whose cities have succumbed to night.

Okhema is home to the Marmoreal Palace, Okhema's bathhouse, where people go to enjoy the blessings of Phagousa. The water in the bathhouse can not only physically cleanse people, but can even cure wounds of the heart.

Points of Interest:

Court of Seasons: It is said that each bath in the Marmoreal Palace possesses a different blessing, making the bather feel different from different "oceans"... In actual fact, only the temperatures of the baths are different.
 
Garden of Life: In the past, "Reason" granted the holy city a seed. Now, this seed has become a garden, passing down wisdom and nurturing life for this broken era.

Hero's Bath: A luxurious bath prepared to reward the heroes saving the world. However, this is more than just a place for their comfort, for it also serves as the door that leads them to their mission's end...

Hall of Respite: After enjoying the soothing bath, people gather here to taste the honey brew and delicacies blessed by Phagousa, enjoying a joyous banquet before Eschatos.

Overflowing Bath: The largest bath in the Palace that Phagousa once shared with the people, resulting in the bath water surging like waves. The lively atmosphere here makes you feel surging waves of emotion.

Kephale Plaza: A plaza constructed to honor the miracles of Kephale. Many followers can be seen praying here... As well as numerous citizens wandering around with nothing better to do.

Marmoreal Palace: The giant baths blessed by Phagousa. People gather here to enjoy the joys of banquets and honey brew, and to immerse themselves in the ever-flowing debate and laughter.

Marmoreal Market: The main area where the citizens of Okhema partake in daily activities. The tightly packed shops in this market provide for the daily lives of the residents. Here, they can perhaps enjoy a temporary respite from the troubles of Eschatos looming outside the city.

Path of Parting: A path leading beyond the dawn. Follow the path to reach the fallen city of Janusopolis — a place now referred to as the Abyss of Fate.

Janus' Steed: A giant wooden horse. It might have plenty of goodies hidden in its belly. If you want to open this securely closed door, you need to offer some Memory Crystal Shards in trade.

Akmonides: As a follower of Zagreus, he delights in manipulating and influencing those around him via gossip and rumors, thoroughly enjoying the chaos he creates.

Chartonus Smithy: A blacksmith shop run by the Grand Craftsman, Chartonus. This Mountain Dweller's craftsmanship is known throughout Okhema. It's said that many of the Chrysos Heirs' weapons were made by him personally.

Dromas Caravan: A merchant caravan composed of dromases that wander Okhema every day. They primarily sell Georios' benedictions. It is said that the caravan visited a great many capitals before the black tide flooded the lands.

Librarium: A Librarium opened by Cerces' faithful. It is said to have been established from the very instant the concept of books was created. The inclusivity towards knowledge is astounding, and everything from academic classics to popular novellas is included here.

Marmoreal Diner: A restaurant located in the best area of Marmoreal Market. Regardless of whether you're looking for local specialties or some long-lost outlandish delicacies, you'll have a chance to sample them here.

Treasure of Ages: An antique shop run by Theodoros. Dolia are also sold here. People call this place the corridor of time, as all the items have their own story, and times past become everlasting in his hands.

entries.name: Janusopolis
entries.content:
Janusopolis is one of the major cities found on Amphoreus. The city worships the three Titans who wove fate: Oronyx, Janus, and Talanton. After the calamity, only a few temples still stand, and they are known as the "Abyss of Fate" or the "Temple of the Three Fates."

Points of Interest:

Destiny's Desolation: A short path leading to Okhema. From how deserted the path is, it is easy to tell that no one has traversed this area in a long time.

Dreamshroud Mausoleum: The area where the Express Coach crashed. A place covered by barren rock and dead woods. It seems as though the guests from beyond the sky have disrupted its long dream.

Everdream Gate: The glorious Gate of Infinity that has now fallen into eternal night. Despite this, its divinity has not diminished in the slightest and the magnificent construction is still awe-inspiring.

Theophany Chamber: The area where priests seek an audience with the Titan. Lingering amongst the broken walls and columns are the dreamy ramblings and murmurs of the Three Titans.

Silent Shroud: A quiet path that leads to the temple. The combination of both the solemn temple and the bleak wilderness creates an eerily quiet atmosphere.

entries.name: Grove of Epiphany
entries.content:
Grove of Epiphany, or just the Grove, is one of the major cities found on Amphoreus.

List of Schools: 

Caprist: Propagation and protection of bizarre beasts.

Erythrokeramists: Philosophy related to the souls, existence and performing "leaps of faith."‍

Helkolithi: Practical study of physical and mental acuities, as well as direct combat.

Lotophagist: Plants.

Nodist: Unknown.	

Nousporist: Unknown.

Venerationist: Rituals, politics and "messy knick-knacks."

entries.name: Castrum Kremnos
entries.content:
Castrum Kremnos is one of the major cities found on Amphoreus.

A massive mobile fortress, the city of warriors who worship Nikador.
The Kremnoans take pride in fighting to the death and are renowned throughout Amphoreus for their strict discipline.
Now, this dilapidated fortress of the corrupted Titan perpetuates the will of conquest and strife.

Before Nikador's descent into madness by the black tide, Castrum Kremnos was the city that primarily worshipped Nikador, the Titan of Strife, due to his use of extreme violence to protect the city and bring balance. The culture of Castrum Kremnos was a very battle-oriented society where fighting and strength was valued above all. Up until the end of the Chrysos War, the city regularly held festivals which were gladiatorial tournaments celebrating Nikador. Individual life wasn't valued as much and for those who died, their souls fueled the power of Nikador's Blade of Fury where they continued to fight alongside Nikador. Castrum Kremnos was governed by both a king and the Castrum Kremnos Council of Elders. The city was known to be very aggressive and for destroying Aquila's sky kingdom and many other city states.

Present People of Note: Mydei (Crown Prince; leader of the Kremnoan Detachment), Miltiades (Member of the Kremnoan Detachment), Chartonus ("Grand Craftsman"), Daros (Baths Attendant), Aelius.

Past People of Note: Nikador (Strife Titan), King Gorgo (Founder and first king), King Eurypon (Father of Mydei), Queen Gorgo (Mother of Mydei), Krateros (King's Aegis; Watcher of Warriors; mentor of Mydei), Ignis, Ptolemy (Member of the Kremnoan Detachment), Leonidas (Sergeant of 5th Squad, 3rd Battalion), Clitun (Recruit of 5th Squad, 3rd Battalion), Hyles ( Warrior), Chironome (Sister of Hyles), Daidalos (Chief Engineer of Kremnos Arena).

Points of Interest:

Conquered Outlands: A path that leads to the arena. Corrupted Titankins of Strife roam within the deserted rooms.

Old Quarry Ground: The abandoned quarry of Castrum Kremnos. Even today, there are still stone materials scattered throughout the area.

Soulchaser Pass: Despite the limited view as you enter this narrow room at the periphery of Kremnos Arena, it is not hard to imagine the fierce battles transcending time and space that once occurred in this arena.

Kremnos Arena: The center of the magnificent Kremnos Arena is where brave warriors showcased their might. Even today, it seems as though you can vaguely hear the cheers and noise from the spectators.

Soul-Forging Ruins: A necessary path to take when heading to the Soul-Forging Zone. All that remains in the area now are the remnant walls.

Silent Chisel Ground: The former sculpting zone of Castrum Kremnos. The stones excavated would be transported here to be worked on by the masons.

Remnant Hall of Truce: The resting area in Kremnos Arena. Warriors who once fought against each other to the death would lay down their arms here, then praise one another for the bravery and skills demonstrated while they rest and recuperate.

entries.name: Castrum Kemnos (Past)
entries.content:
A city that worships Nikador, the Strife Titan who strikes fear into people. The spear that brings terror upon this world is also the shield that protects it from calamity

Points of Interest:

Chisel Zone: An area for polishing and processing stones. The sounds of stonemasonry can be heard here throughout the entire day.

Excavation Ground: The area in Castrum Kremnos where stone is excavated. Many Mountain Dwellers work endlessly here.

Hall of Strife: The temple worshiping Nikador. All the bravest warriors of Castrum Kremnos gather here in hopes of obtaining the Titan's approval and becoming a member of the revered Royal Wing Elites.

Path of Conquest: The entrance to the bridge at the main gate of Castrum Kremnos. The winds of conquest blowing from the city can be felt from a distance away. This is the path taken by the Kremnos army when they depart and return from battle.

Soul-Forging Gate: The doors that lead to the Soul-Forging Zone. The embodiment of Nikador's divinity stands tall within the Soul-Forging Zone. Enter through the door if you have the courage to withstand its gaze.

entries.name: Styxia
entries.content: Styxia is one of the major cities found on Amphoreus.

entries.name: Vortex of Genesis
entries.content:
Vortex of Genesis is an area on Amphoreus.

The starting point of the world, hidden by the waves. A grand sanctuary that houses the primal divinity of the Twelve Titans. It's also the promised land that will see the descent of the Miracle of Genesis, as prophesized by the oracles.

The Astral Zodiac in the Vortex of Genesis has been divided into twelve parts, one for each Titan that record the Flame-Chase Journey of the Chrysos Heirs.

Points of Interest:

World Breeding Meridian: A path leading to the Vortex of Genesis that has been cut off by the fierce waves from the Chalice of Plenty. Only the sacred relics of the "Ocean's" priests can allow access to this place.

Tidal Bounty: The spirit basin at the heart of the Vortex of Genesis is the sacred vessel for sealing the Coreflame. It seems to be home to a spirit that longs for ambrosia. Offering the collected Celestial Ambrosia into the basin and the echoes of the tides may bestow you with a gift in return...

entries.name: Coreflames
entries.content:
The Coreflames are the birthplace of the Titans, and each Coreflame is tied to a certain Titan's divinity. Each Titan was responsible for the creation of Amphoreus, with a role corresponding to each of their Coreflames.
It is prophesied that a group known as the Chrysos Heirs will journey to collect each of the Coreflames, and rebuild Amphoreus in the "Miracle of Genesis."

As of the completion of Trailblaze Mission Hero, Bear Thy Coreflame, the group possess seven of the twelve Coreflames, and hold them within the Vortex of Genesis.

Known Coreflames:

Coreflame: Strife, Status: Coreflame returned, Titan: Nikador, Chrysos Heir: Unconfirmed.

Coreflame: Trickery, Status: Coreflame returned, Titan: Zagreus, Chrysos Heir: Cipher.

Coreflame: Death, Status: Unknown, Titan: Thanatos, Chrysos Heir: Castorice.

Coreflame: Earth, Status: Coreflame returned, Titan: Georios, Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

Coreflame: Ocean, Status:  Coreflame returned, Titan:  Phagousa, Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

Coreflame: Sky, Status:  Unknown, Titan:  Aquila, Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

Coreflame: Worldbearing, Status:  Coreflame sacrificed, Titan:  Kephale, Chrysos Heir: Unconfirmed.

Coreflame: Romance, Status:  Coreflame returned, Titan:  Mnestia, Chrysos Heir: Aglaea.

Coreflame: Reason, Status:  Unknown, Titan:  Cerces, Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

Coreflame: Passage, Status:  Coreflame returned, Titan:  Janus, Chrysos Heir: Tribios.

Coreflame: Law, Status:  Coreflame returned, Titan:  Talanton, Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

Coreflame: Time, Status:  Possessed by Oronyx, Titan:  Oronyx, Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

entries.name: Titans
entries.content:
"The Titans of Amphoreus are the forces that sustain the heavens and the earth, the fates flowing from ancient times to the present, and the rules governing all things in the world. Mortals live within their joys and sorrows — knowledge, war, love, life, and death are all deeply entwined with their divine authority."

The Titans are a group of gods born from the Coreflames sent down by the gods of Amphoreus. Each Titan has an associated Coreflame, and whoever conquers the Coreflame's Trial can inherit the Titan's power and become a demigod. This group was responsible for the creations of the first heaven, earth, morals, and the calendar.

At this point, the Titans have all fallen, and the Chrysos Heirs are prophesied to take up the Coreflames.

Three Titans of Fate:

1. Month: Month of Gate, Name: Janus, Title: Gate of Infinity, Coreflame: Passage, Status: Deceased (coreflame returned), Associated Chrysos Heir: Tribios.

2. Month: Month of Balance, Name: Talanton, Title: Scale of Justice, Coreflame: Law, Status: Deceased (coreflame returned), Associated Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

3. Month: Month of Evernight, Name: Oronyx, Title: Veil of Evernight, Coreflame: Time, Status: Alive, Associated Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

Three Titans of Foundation:

4. Month: Month of Cultivation, Name: Georios, Title: Pillar of Stone, Coreflame: Earth, Status: Deceased (coreflame returned), Associated Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

5. Month: Month of Joy, Name: Phagousa, Title: Chalice of Plenty, Coreflame: Ocean, Status: Deceased (coreflame returned), Associated Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

6. Month: Month of Everday, Name: Aquila, Title: Eye of Twilight, Coreflame: Sky, Status: Unknown (closed eyes), Associated Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

Three Titans of Creation:

7. Month: Month of Freedom, Name: Kephale, Title: Throne of Worlds, Coreflame: Worldbearing, Status: Asleep, Associated Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

8. Month: Month of Reaping, Name: Cerces, Title: Bough of Rift, Coreflame: Reason, Status: Deceased, Associated Chrysos Heir: Unknown.

9. Month: Month of Weaving, Name: Mnestia, Title: Chrysalis of Gold, Coreflame: Romance, Status: Deceased (coreflame returned), Associated Chrysos Heir: Aglaea.

Three Titans of Calamity:

10. Month: Month of Strife, Name: Nikador, Title: Lance of Fury, Coreflame: Strife, Status: Deceased (coreflame returned), Associated Chrysos Heir: Mydei.

11. Month: Month of Mourning, Name: Thanatos, Title: Hand of Shadow, Coreflame: Death, Status: Unknown, Associated Chrysos Heir: Castorice.

12. Month: Month of Fortune, Name: Zagreus, Title: Coin of Whimsy, Coreflame: Trickery, Status: Deceased (coreflame returned), Associated Chrysos Heir: Cipher.

entries.name: Demigods
entries.content:
"Tribios took up Janus' Coreflame, becoming the first demigod. Since then, many other Chrysos Heir heroes have undergone trials, received the divine authority of the Titans, and become demigods, maintaining the order of the world."

Demigods are Chrysos Heirs who have inherited the Titans' Coreflames.

When a Titan's Coreflame is plucked, a chosen Chrysos Heir must undergo a divine trial to take their Coreflame. Tribios became the first demigod after taking Janus' Coreflame of Passage.

Unlike Tribios and Aglaea, who publicly lead the people of Amphoreus, the Chrysos Heir who inherited Talanton's Coreflame is nowhere to be found. Nevertheless, they are still performing their duty since the laws that govern the world are still in place.

Phainon is currently undergoing Nikador's divine trial to inherit the Coreflame of Strife.

Known Demigods:

Name: Aglaea, Divine Authority: Mnestia, Chrysalis of Gold, Coreflame: Romance.

Name: Tribios, Divine Authority: Janus, Gate of Infinity, Coreflame: Passage.

Name: Cifera, Divine Authority: Zagreus, Coin of Whimsy, Coreflame: Trickery.

Name: Unknown, Divine Authority: Talanton, Scale of Justice, Coreflame: Law.

Name: Unknown, Divine Authority: Georios, Pillar of Stone, Coreflame: Earth.

Name: Unknown, Divine Authority: Phagousa, Chalice of Plenty, Coreflame: Ocean.

entries.name: Council of Elders
entries.content:
The Council of Elders is a faction in Amphoreus. They are the main governing bodies within the cities of Amphoreus.

The Council of Elders are in charge of the day-to-day affairs of the cities in Amphoreus. Each city has their own Council of Elders with their roles varying between cities.

Okhema: Okhema's Council of Elders have temporarily transferred their power to Aglaea and the Chrysos Heirs due to the dire situation on Amphoreus. Most of the Council of Elders seem to dislike the Chrysos Heirs and the prophecy. According to Elder Caenis, the Council of Elders positions are "entrusted to us by the people of Okhema" hinting there might be a democratic process for electing elders in Okhema. Okhema's Council of Elders mostly despise the Chrysos Heirs as almost half of the council has voted against transferring power to the Chrysos Heirs and are continuely plotting against the Chrysos Heirs to this day.

Castrum Kremnos: Revealed by Mem through a Memory Fragment, before the fall of Castrum Kremnos, the Council of Elders in Castrum Kremnos made a deal with the Mountain Dwellers, freeing them from slavery and servitude from the city.

Known Members: Elder Caenis, Callictis, Oenone, Diogena's grandfather.

entries.name: Chrysos Heirs
entries.content:
It is said that as Kephale's divine radiance dimmed, they offered their own Coreflame and left behind the Oracle of Creation.
Afterward, heroes imbued with great power began to walk the earth. They carried in their veins golden divine blood and were known as the "Chrysos Heirs."

The Chrysos Heirs are a group of people chosen by a prophecy from Kephale. Their purpose is to pluck the Coreflames from the Titans, and uphold the world, also called as a "Flame-Chase."

According to the prophecy, a person that conquers a Coreflame's Trial will inherit its respective Titan's divinity, becoming a demigod.

Known Members:

Name: Aglaea, Title: The Goldweaver, Affiliated City: Okhema, Divine Authority: Mnestia, Chrysalis of Gold, Flame-Chaser's Path: Romance.

Name: Tribios, Title: The Messengerr, Affiliated City: Janusopolis, Okhema, Divine Authority: Janus, Gate of Infinity, Flame-Chaser's Path: Passage.

Name: Anaxagoras (Anaxa), Title:  The Foolish, Affiliated City: Unknown, Divine Authority: Unknown, Flame-Chaser's Path: Unknown.

Name: Hyacine, Title:  Unknown, Affiliated City: Unknown, Divine Authority: Unknown, Flame-Chaser's Path: Unknown.

Name: Mydeimos (Mydei), Title: The Undyingr, Affiliated City: Castrum Kremnos, Divine Authority: Nikador, Lance of Fury...?, Flame-Chaser's Path: Strife.

Name: Cifera, Title: The Fleet-Footed, Affiliated City: Unknown, Divine Authority: Zagreus, Coin of Whimsy, Flame-Chaser's Path: Trickery.

Name: Castorice, Title: Unknown, Affiliated City: Aidonia, Divine Authority: Thanatos, Hand of Shadow, Flame-Chaser's Path: Death.

Name: Phainon, Title: The Deliverer, Affiliated City: Aedes Elysiae, Divine Authority: Kephale, Throne of Worlds, Flame-Chaser's Path: Worldbearing.

Name: Hysilens, Title: Unknown, Affiliated City: Unknown, Divine Authority: Unknown, Flame-Chaser's Path: Unknown.

Name: Unknown, Title: Unknown, Affiliated City: Unknown, Divine Authority: Unknown, Flame-Chaser's Path: Unknown.

Name: Unknown, Title: Unknown, Affiliated City: Unknown, Divine Authority: Unknown, Flame-Chaser's Path: Unknown.
